identity.title: 海岸竖屏真实制作验收

decode.audioNote: Container nb_frames=1378 and decoded AAC frame count=1377 are different codec accounting quantities; strict complete decode returned zero errors. This audit does not assess speech naturalness, language, identity or perceived audio gaps.

thresholds.pixelValueSpace: Native decoded 8-bit YUV420p planes; no resize or range-normalization. Y/U/V each 0–255; thresholds cover both nominal video-range black/white and full-range extremes.

nearUniformColour.planeRule: Maximum fraction contained in any 5 consecutive code values

scenes.text: 白色的浪花在沙滩边铺展开来。
海面随着波浪起伏，水面的光影也不断变化。
沿着海岸望去，一道道浪花接连靠近，又缓缓退回海中。
站在海边，我们能够看见海水不断流动，也能看见海岸的辽阔。

localImageInspection.method: Viewed local contact sheets made from this same existing MP4. No generated replacement imagery and no external visual review call.
observations: Frames 74–84 show a textured rocks/surf to sandy-beach cut; no blank interval visible in the selected evidence frames.
Frames 208–218 show beach to golden water reflections; bright highlights occupy part of a textured image.
Frames 414–424 show the declared approximately 0.266667-second dissolve (8 output-frame periods) from water reflections to sunset shore.
Frames 649–659 show the declared hard cut from bright sunset shore to a darker rocky coastline. The new scene persists rather than appearing as an isolated black pulse.

Frame 286 (9.533333s), with the highest near-black pixel fraction, contains dark waves and strong golden reflections. Frame 869 (28.966667s), with the lowest mean Y, contains textured coastline and dark water. Neither is a near-full-black or flat-colour frame under the declared criteria.

conclusion.supported: All 881 decoded frames of the identified existing export are complete and regularly timed. No near-full-black, near-full-white or near-uniform-colour frame was detected under the explicit thresholds, including all four edit-boundary windows. No conservative 1–3-frame global luminance pulse candidate was detected.

conclusion.naturalDarkness: Low mean luminance alone is not a blank-frame classification. Natural dark water/coastline retains texture and reflected light; full-frame coverage and per-plane concentration thresholds distinguish these observed frames from black/white/flat-colour inserts.
